zh: 我们只带了手提行李，所以不用等托运的箱子。
en: We only took hand {luggage|baggage}, so we didn't have to wait for any checked bags.

zh: 因为大雾，我们的出发时间推迟了两个小时。
en: Our {departure} was delayed by two hours because of fog.

zh: 我会把南岛之行的行程表发邮件给你。
en: I'll email you the {itinerary} for our South Island trip.

zh: 我们过海关时必须申报那罐蜂蜜。
en: We had to declare the jar of honey at {customs}.

zh: 因为风浪太大，惠灵顿和皮克顿之间的渡轮都停航了。
en: The {ferries} between Wellington and Picton were cancelled because of rough seas.

zh: 去奥克兰的火车从三号站台出发。
en: The train to Auckland leaves from {platform} three.

zh: 今年公交车票价又涨了。
en: Bus {fares} went up again this year.

zh: 你订好皇后镇的住宿了吗？
en: Have you booked your {accommodation} in Queenstown yet?

zh: 我给爸妈买了几件纪念品。
en: I bought a few {souvenirs} for my parents.

zh: 我们要在新加坡中途停留六个小时。
en: We have a six-hour {layover|stopover} in Singapore.

zh: 我的护照下个月到期，得去换新的了。
en: My {passport} expires next month, so I need to renew it.

zh: 去澳大利亚旅游需要签证吗？
en: Do I need a {visa} to visit Australia?

zh: 我们的航班正在十二号登机口登机。
en: Our flight is boarding at {gate} twelve.

zh: 您想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位？
en: Would you like a window seat or an {aisle} seat?

zh: 开了十个小时的车，我们终于到达了目的地。
en: After ten hours on the road, we finally reached our {destination}.

zh: 从奥克兰到惠灵顿的火车旅程大约要十一个小时。
en: The train {journey|trip|ride} from Auckland to Wellington takes about eleven hours.

zh: 我们的两个行李箱都超重了。
en: Both of our {suitcases|bags|cases} were over the weight limit.

zh: 所有乘客都必须系好安全带。
en: All {passengers} must fasten their seat belts.

zh: 今天早上高速公路上有严重的延误。
en: There are long {delays} on the motorway this morning.

zh: 值机柜台前排起了长长的队伍。
en: There were huge {queues|lines} at the check-in counters.

zh: 斐济用的是什么货币？
en: What {currency} do they use in Fiji?

zh: 我把所有东西都装在一个背包里。
en: I carried everything in one {backpack|rucksack}.

zh: 为了省钱，我们一路住的都是便宜的青年旅舍。
en: We stayed in cheap {hostels|backpackers} the whole way to save money.

zh: 我有预订，名字是陈。
en: I have a {reservation|booking} under the name Chen.

zh: 出门前查一下公交车时刻表。
en: Check the bus {timetable|schedule} before you leave.

zh: 在下一个出口下高速公路。
en: Take the next exit off the {motorway|highway|freeway}.

zh: 到了环岛走第二个出口。
en: Take the second exit at the {roundabout}.

zh: 导航建议了一条更快的路线。
en: The GPS suggested a faster {route|way}.

zh: 奥克兰以北的有些公路要交过路费。
en: You have to pay {tolls} on some roads north of Auckland.

zh: 我们的酒店房间可以看到海港和进出的船只。
en: Our hotel room looked out over the {harbour|harbor} and the boats coming in and out.

zh: 疫情期间，好几个国家关闭了边境。
en: Several countries closed their {borders} during the pandemic.

zh: 我们的导游带我们逛了老城区。
en: Our {guide} showed us around the old town.

zh: 邮轮行程里包含一次去冰川的一日短途游览。
en: The cruise includes a day {excursion|trip} to the glacier.

zh: 飞行途中气流颠簸很厉害，安全带指示灯一直亮着。
en: There was a lot of {turbulence} during the flight, so the seat belt sign stayed on.

zh: 第一段航班晚点了，所以我们没赶上转乘的航班。
en: Our first flight was late, so we missed our {connection|connecting flight}.

zh: 计划有变，我们改成周五出发。
en: There's been a {change} of plans, so we're leaving on Friday instead.

zh: 起飞一小时后，机组人员开始送晚餐。
en: The cabin {crew} served dinner an hour after take-off.

zh: 山顶的景色美极了。
en: The {views} from the top of the mountain were amazing.

zh: 我给全家人订了去悉尼的往返机票。
en: I booked return {tickets|flights} to Sydney for the whole family.

zh: 因为暴风雨，所有从惠灵顿起飞的航班都取消了。
en: All {flights} out of Wellington were cancelled because of the storm.

zh: 请问这两个座位有人坐吗？
en: Excuse me, are these two {seats} taken?

zh: 你的日本之行怎么样？
en: How was your {trip|holiday} to Japan?

zh: 夏天这个海滩上挤满了游客。
en: The beach is packed with {tourists|visitors} in summer.

zh: 你为这次旅行买旅游保险了吗？
en: Did you buy travel {insurance} for this trip?

zh: 我们在湖边的一个露营地搭了帐篷。
en: We pitched our tent at a {campsite|campground|camping ground} by the lake.

zh: 他们退休后坐邮轮环游了太平洋群岛。
en: After they retired, they went on a {cruise} around the Pacific Islands.

zh: 天空塔是奥克兰最有名的地标之一。
en: The Sky Tower is one of Auckland's best-known {landmarks}.

zh: 我们在行李转盘旁边等了四十分钟。
en: We waited at the baggage {carousel} for forty minutes.

zh: 我们在候机厅喝了杯咖啡，等着登机。
en: We had a coffee in the departure {lounge} while we waited to board.

zh: 在城里走了一整天，我的脚疼死了。
en: My {feet} were killing me after walking around the city all day.
